title: Loch Lomond inn is one of Scotland's 'most haunted' pubs
excerpt: The Drovers Inn in Inverarnan is known for its spooky stories and legends
content:
Cold spots, things flying off walls, and thuds in the middle of the night – just some of the ghostly goings-on at Scotland’s “most haunted” pub.

The Drovers Inn in Inverarnan is well-known for its spooky stories and legends, which attract visitors from far and wide.

Built in 1705, the hotel sits at the northern end of Loch Lomond.

Every room at the Drovers is associated with some form of paranormal activity.

Staff member Wendy Dickson said: “We’ve got room two – it’s meant to be one of the rooms that gets really cold through the night.

“Room three we had a psychic in and she picked about ten or 12 ghosts.”

Most spooky reports, however, come from room six.

Legend has it the room is haunted by the ghost of a young girl, Annabelle, who drowned in the River Falloch while trying to retrieve her doll.

Her body is believed to have been laid out in room six before her burial.

Lily Sharp, a psychic medium, experienced brushes with the supernatural within an hour of checking into the room.

She said: “I set a few cat balls up, they’re motion detectors really.

“When we were just chilling on the bed the motion detector for the cat ball went off.

“I’m hoping there’s going to be some activity. I really do. I’ll maybe get some more stories.”
